pinev: 1906 Dubuque Co plat, Jefferson Twp p. 9 (Ancestry image 31617_072142-00253): 'Maxwell', about 35 acres in the N part of sec 30 T90N R1E, immediately E of the Rickardsville village plat (BLM sec 30 = 42.5723-42.5869, -90.8978..-90.8781).
1906 plat re-read: the village plat is in N-central sec 30 and the Maxwell tract lies E of it, running to the sec 29 line (NE sec 30); pin there, r200.
1915 Iowa census: John Datisman, 65, farmer, Jefferson Twp, P.O. Durango RFD, owns $9,000; on the 1906 plate he is in sec 35 by Durango, so he held the Maxwell place by 1915.
